reason: Backward Euler replaced variable-step BDF2 as the 3D default, because BDF2 does not conserve water when sources change (an emitter switched on and off under adaptive stepping lost 1.6% of its water; MODFLOW 6 Test 2 under adaptive BDF2 ended 29 cm low). Backward Euler's larger time error at this case's fixed 900 s steps raises its RMSE by 7%.
